A '''hepatizon sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper sword]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. It is a fast, light sword with [[Riposte]] II.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Hepatizon Sword|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Hepatizon Sword|attackspeed}}, faster than any sword except the [[electrum sword]], which it ties. It has {{Value|Hepatizon Sword|durability}} durability. While held in the main hand it adds 0.0105 to movement speed, 10.5% of the player's base speed.

=== Intrinsics ===
[[Riposte]] II is an intrinsic: it is stored on the item and applied when the sword enters a player's inventory.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_sword.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.
